## Changes

Describe the change and link its issue, roadmap milestone or architecture decision.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. For a public API change, link the specification and include the migration impact. For interaction changes, describe the keyboard, focus or pointer coverage.

Sign off your commits as described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/ronmilich/eroxo-ui/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
